bible_verses.telugu: అందుకునా కృప నీకు చాలును, బలహీనతయందు నాశక్తి పరిపూర్ణమగుచున్నదని ఆయన నాతో చెప్పెను. కాగా క్రీస్తు శక్తి నామీద నిలిచియుండు నిమిత్తము, విశేషముగా నా బలహీనతలయందె
bible_verses.english: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.' Therefore I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ’s power may rest on me.

bible_verses.telugu: మనము దేవుని పిల్లలమని పిలువబడునట్లు తండ్రి మనకెట్టి ప్రేమ ననుగ్రహించెనొ చూడుడి; మనము దేవుని పిల్లలమే.ఈ హేతువుచేత లోకము మనలను ఎరుగదు, ఏల యనగా అది ఆయనను ఎరుగలేదు.
bible_verses.english: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know him.

bible_verses.telugu: మరణమైనను జీవమైనను దేవదూతలైనను ప్రధానులైనను ఉన్నవియైనను రాబోవున వియైనను అధికారులైనను ఎత్తయినను లోతైనను సృష్టింపబడిన మరి ఏదైనను, మన ప్రభువైన క్రీస్తు యేసునందలి దేవుని ప్రేమనుండి మనలను ఎడబాప నేరవని రూఢిగా నమ్ముచున్నాను.
bible_verses.english: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers, neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for loving me even when I struggle to feel it. When doubts whisper that I am not enough, help me to anchor my heart in Your truth instead of my emotions. Remind me today that my strength comes from You and that I am safely held in Your hands. I choose to believe what You say about me above every other voice. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, thank You for loving me even when I struggle to feel it. When doubts whisper that I am not enough, help me to anchor my heart in Your truth instead of my emotions. Remind me today that my strength comes from You and that I am safely held in Your hands. I choose to believe what You say about me above every other voice. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: It is so easy to let the noisy thoughts of inadequacy dictate how we feel about ourselves, but God’s voice speaks a deeper, unchanging truth over our lives. When we feel weak, unseen, or unsure of where we stand, He gently reminds us that our identity is anchored in His relentless love. As you sing today, let go of the lies that say you aren't enough, and open your heart to receive who Jesus says you are—deeply loved, held, and forever His.
